spans.s:
Conj. A particle implying like-
ness, and, so, like.

एवम्भूत (तः-ता-तं)
a. So, such, in
such manner.

एवम्वि_ध^1 (धः-धा-धं)
a. So, such, of
such kind.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Dhaval Patel on 20160513. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/295. note: print error Alphabetic misordering. b after B..
